note: Designed by specification and search — see tools/design-creatures.js. Ordinary devo2 genomes; nothing here is a new type or a role.

creatures.name: Filament
creatures.about: A long thin chain. The simplest way to be more than a blob, and the body plan a travelling wave needs before it can be a gait.

creatures.name: Lash
creatures.about: Elongated and almost entirely muscle, with the mass at one end. Everything spent on force; nothing spent on knowing where it is.

creatures.name: Sentinel
creatures.about: Sensor-heavy and barely mobile. Bets everything on knowing what is nearby, which only pays in a world where something is.

creatures.name: Holdfast
creatures.about: A gripping base with a small crown. Built to stay put in a current and let the water bring things to it.

creatures.name: Grappler
creatures.about: Anchors at the extremities, muscle between them. The anchor-extend-anchor-contract ratchet, laid out as a body rather than a behaviour.

creatures.name: Cuirass
creatures.about: Compact and armoured. Pays a metabolic rent every second for a defence that only matters if something is trying to eat it.

creatures.name: Digestor
creatures.about: Soft, unarmoured, and specialised in what it can break down. The opposite bet to Cuirass: eat well, do not bother surviving being eaten.

creatures.name: Fan
creatures.about: Broad and flat, maximum surface for minimum tissue. Everything it does, it does with the outside of itself.

creatures.name: Mirror
creatures.about: Strongly bilateral. Two of everything, one on each side, which is what a body needs before it can turn rather than merely move.

creatures.name: Chimera
creatures.about: All four tissues in balance. Not optimised for anything — built to test whether division of labour survives contact with the economy.
